# x402 RAG Chunker

> Deterministic, agent-friendly text chunking for RAG pipelines. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/chunk – service info
- POST /api/chunk – paid chunking

## Pricing

~0.006 – 0.02 USDC per call (default max 0.012 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "text": "your long document here...",
  "options": {
    "chunkSize": 512,
    "overlap": 64,
    "strategy": "sentence"
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "chunks": ["chunk1", "chunk2", ...],
  "meta": { "count": 12, "avgLength": 480, ... }
}
```

Ideal for autonomous agents preparing context for vector stores or multi-step reasoning.
